actions.action: Enforce expiry locally, including during connectivity loss.
actions.mechanism: Conservative expiry checks prevent late display despite the clock’s bounded 30-second error.
actions.implementation: Hide timestamped items when device time reaches expiry minus 30 seconds. Schedule removal independently of networking; recheck before rendering after resume.
actions.check: Disconnect for six hours with clocks offset ±30 seconds; verify no timestamped item remains visible past expiry, including across suspend/resume.
actions.risk: Items may disappear up to 60 seconds early.

actions.action: Replace configurations atomically with versioned authoritative snapshots.
actions.mechanism: Complete snapshots make absence authoritative; persistent generation fences reject stale responses without accumulating removal records.
actions.implementation: Assign strictly increasing bundle generations; atomically persist snapshot and generation. Reject older generations. Enforce encoded bundles below 100 KB before publication.
actions.check: Remove an item, reconnect, then replay older bundles and reboot mid-update; verify the removed revision never returns after removal commits.
actions.risk: Oversized snapshots block publication; offline emergency removal remains impossible.

actions.action: Show freshness limits beside offline announcements.
actions.mechanism: Separate expiry enforcement from revocation freshness so cached validity is not mistaken for current authorization.
actions.implementation: Show last successfully synchronized time and: “Offline: expiry enforced; removals cannot be checked. Until-revoked announcements may remain.” Never refresh this time on failed attempts.
actions.check: During six disconnected hours, confirm the notice remains visible, synchronization time stays unchanged, and until-revoked items are not falsely labelled current.
actions.risk: Viewers may overlook the notice; it cannot enforce emergency removal.
